title: XOCB Multi-User Security
summary: Classical single-user security is considered for XOCB, but its security in the multi-user setting remains unanalyzed.

formal_statement.body: For XOCB, classical single-user security is considered, while multi-user security is left open. The unresolved task is to analyze XOCB in a multi-user security model.

scope.domain: Authenticated-encryption mode security in classical single-user and multi-user settings.
parameters: XOCB, the authenticated-encryption mode under analysis
scope.unresolved_remainder: Analyze XOCB security in a multi-user security model.

citations.label: XOCB: Beyond-Birthday-Bound Secure Authenticated Encryption Mode with Rate-One Computation

progress.summary: The source explicitly states that it considers classical single-user security for XOCB and leaves multi-user security open.
